acquisition_method.evidence: Peptides were analyzed on a nano UHPLC 1000 (Proxeon) coupled via a nanoelectrospray ionization source to a Q-ExactiveTM Plus Hybrid-Quadrupol OrbitrapTM Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San José, CA, USA) operating in a top 12 data-dependent mode (DDA), as described, but using a 2 h gradient.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: After reduction (10 mM DTT) and cystein alkylation (55 mM CAA), proteins were sequentially digested with LysC (0.5 μL 0.05 mg/mL, 3 h RT), diluted with 50 mM Ammoniumbicarbonate to 2 M Urea, and incubated with Trypsin (1 μL 0.05 mg/mL) overnight.
